low-energy ion beam is one of many effective gene mutation inducers in E. coli, and it has some special mutagenic effects on lacI gene.

low-energy nitrogen ion beam irradiation induced high level of lacI gene mutations and increased the proportion of additions and +/-TGGC in Escherichian coli W3110, which was quite different from the gamma-radiation and oxygen free-radical.

low-energy ion irradiated induced a significant number of mutations in the lacI gene of Escherichia coil K12, and the mutation spectrum is similar to those induced by oxygen free-radicals, suggesting that free radicals or other adducts might play an important part in mutagenesis in low-energy ion irradiations.
